---
title: "French Motor: complete modelling workflow"
---

```{r}
# Load packages -----------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(broom)
library(poissonreg)


# 1. Load data ------------------------------------------------------------

load("data/freMTPL2freq.RData")

mtpl_freq <- freMTPL2freq


# 2. Create group_id from original risk characteristics ------------------

mtpl_freq <- mtpl_freq %>%
  group_by(
    across(-c(IDpol, Exposure, ClaimNb))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group_id = cur_group_id()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# 3. Prepare modelling data -----------------------------------------------

mtpl_freq_model <- mtpl_freq %>%
  mutate(
    ClaimNb = pmin(as.integer(ClaimNb), 4),
    VehAge = pmin(VehAge, 20),
    DrivAge = pmin(DrivAge, 90),
    BonusMalus = pmin(BonusMalus, 150),
    Density = round(log(Density), 2),
    VehGas = factor(VehGas),
    Exposure = pmin(Exposure, 1),

    area_glm = factor(Area),

    veh_power_glm =
      factor(pmin(VehPower, 9)),

    veh_age_glm = cut(
      VehAge,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 10, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "new",
        "1_10",
        "over_10"
      )
    ),

    driver_age_glm = cut(
      DrivAge,
      breaks = c(
        -Inf, 20, 25, 30,
        40, 50, 70, Inf
      ),
      labels = c(
        "under_20",
        "20_25",
        "25_30",
        "30_40",
        "40_50",
        "50_70",
        "over_70"
      )
    ),

    bonus_malus_glm =
      pmin(BonusMalus, 150),

    density_glm = Density,

    Region = relevel(
      factor(Region),
      ref = "R24"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    veh_age_glm =
      relevel(veh_age_glm, ref = "1_10"),

    driver_age_glm =
      relevel(driver_age_glm, ref = "40_50")
  )


# 4. Check group_id -------------------------------------------------------

mtpl_freq_model %>%
  select(
    IDpol,
    ClaimNb,
    Exposure,
    group_id
  ) %>%
  head(10)

sum(is.na(mtpl_freq_model$group_id))


# 5. Grouped train/test split --------------------------------------------

set.seed(100)

mtpl_split <- group_initial_split(
  mtpl_freq_model,
  group = group_id,
  prop = 0.80
)

mtpl_train <- training(mtpl_split)
mtpl_test <- testing(mtpl_split)

# 6. Verify the train/test split -----------------------------------------

length(
  intersect(
    unique(mtpl_train$group_id),
    unique(mtpl_test$group_id)
  )
)


# 7. Specify the Poisson GLM ---------------------------------------------

freq_glm_spec <- poisson_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm")


# 8. Fit the Poisson GLM -------------------------------------------------

freq_glm_fit <- freq_glm_spec %>%
  fit(
    ClaimNb ~
      area_glm +
      veh_power_glm +
      veh_age_glm +
      driver_age_glm +
      bonus_malus_glm +
      density_glm +
      VehBrand +
      VehGas +
      Region +
      offset(log(Exposure)),
    data = mtpl_train
  )


# 9. Examine model coefficients ------------------------------------------

tidy(freq_glm_fit)


# 10. Generate training predictions --------------------------------------

freq_train_results <- mtpl_train %>%
  bind_cols(
    predict(
      freq_glm_fit,
      new_data = mtpl_train,
      type = "numeric"
    )
  )


# 11. Generate test predictions ------------------------------------------

freq_test_results <- mtpl_test %>%
  bind_cols(
    predict(
      freq_glm_fit,
      new_data = mtpl_test,
      type = "numeric"
    )
  )


# 12. Compare observed and predicted portfolio frequency ----------------

freq_test_results %>%
  summarise(
    observed_frequency =
      sum(ClaimNb) / sum(Exposure),

    predicted_frequency =
      sum(.pred) / sum(Exposure)
  )



# 13. Calculate Poisson deviance ------------------------------------------

freq_test_results <- freq_test_results %>%
  mutate(
    poisson_deviance = 2 * if_else(
      ClaimNb == 0,
      .pred,
      ClaimNb * log(ClaimNb / .pred) -
        (ClaimNb - .pred)
    )
  )


# 14. Summarise test-set Poisson deviance --------------------------------

freq_test_results %>%
  summarise(
    observed_frequency =
      sum(ClaimNb) / sum(Exposure),

    predicted_frequency =
      sum(.pred) / sum(Exposure),

    frequency_difference =
      predicted_frequency - observed_frequency,

    mean_poisson_deviance =
      mean(poisson_deviance)
  )

```
